claims.claim_text: The summit announced tariff reductions covering about $30 billion of goods and extended the tariff truce to January 10, 2027.

claims.investor_implication: Do not use the stated yield levels or record comparison without dated market data.

numeric_parse.observed: No relevant survey or yield observations supplied

claims.investor_implication: Do not present survey expectations or cross-market yields as verified current levels.

claims.claim_text: Bill Ackman argued that higher rates might not curb AI and energy investment and could raise financing costs and inflation; the broadcast also claimed AI investment exceeds 30% of US GDP.

numeric_parse.claimed: AI investment exceeds 30% of US GDP
numeric_parse.observed: No definition, calculation, or GDP source supplied

claims.investor_implication: Exclude the 30% GDP statistic from investment conclusions pending a reproducible calculation.

claims.claim_text: Samsung Electronics' third-quarter operating-profit consensus was said to be about KRW 22 trillion above the prior quarter, with a possible fourth consecutive record quarter; the captioned profit figures have inconsistent digits.

numeric_parse.observed: No source figures supplied; captioned digits are inconsistent

claims.investor_implication: Do not publish or calculate from the captioned profit amounts until checked against filings and the consensus source.

claims.claim_text: Samsung's HBM4 revenue would ramp in the third quarter, HBM revenue would more than triple quarter on quarter, and HBM4 base-die production could improve foundry results or enable a profit.

numeric_parse.claimed: HBM revenue more than 3 times the prior quarter
numeric_parse.observed: No company revenue figure or guidance supplied

claims.investor_implication: Keep the HBM sales and foundry-profit assumptions separate in earnings scenarios.

claims.claim_text: A KB Securities forecast put HBM at 27%, 33%, and 40% of Samsung DRAM capacity in 2025–2027; server DDR5 lead times rose from about 6 to as much as 52 weeks; third-quarter DRAM prices were projected to rise 13–18% versus about 55% in the second quarter.

numeric_parse.claimed: HBM capacity share 27%/33%/40%; DDR5 lead time 6 to 52 weeks; DRAM price change 13–18% versus about 55%

claims.investor_implication: Do not model supply constraints or pricing from these figures without their original definitions and dates.

claims.claim_text: Presenters cited a KOSPI upside view of 7,500–7,700, an estimated USD/KRW rate near 1,360, and anecdotal movement by some investors into US equities.

numeric_parse.observed: Later ^KS11 snapshot 6,889.74; no USD/KRW or flow data

claims.investor_implication: Avoid drawing margin or market-share conclusions from these cross-country prices until they are made comparable.
